messages.出血回数を大きく増やして出血編成を支える人格。速度が低めなので、味方がマッチを取: An Identity that supports Bleed teams by adding substantial Bleed Count. Her relatively low Speed favors landing unopposed attacks after allies have taken the clashes, adding Count to those enemies.
messages.出血回数の付与: S2「後始末」のⅡコインで出血回数1/3増加、S3「雲の撹乱」: **Inflicting Bleed Count**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 Clean Up increases Bleed Count by 1/3, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 Lenticular Swirl increases it by 3 on hit. She inflicts 2 Bleed Potency on Coin Ⅰ hit of S2 and on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit of S3.
messages.低めの速度: 速度2~5/2~6/3~6。先に動く味方の後から一方攻撃を入れやす: **Lowish Speed**: Speed 2–5/2–6/3–6. It is easy for her to land one-sided attacks after faster allies act.
messages.敵のスキルを弱めるデバフ: S1「発勁」のⅠコインで麻痺1/3(1ターンの間、数: **Debuffs that weaken enemy skills**: Coin Ⅰ of S1 Focus Strike inflicts 1/3 Paralyze (fixes the Coin Power of that many Coins to 0 for 1 turn), Coin Ⅱ of S2 inflicts 2 Damage Down on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 inflicts 5 Offense Level Down on hit. Paralyze backfires against skills with negative Coin Power.
messages.出血回数で強化: 対象の出血回数がS1は2以上でダメージ量+20%、S2は5以上: **Bonuses from Bleed Count**: +20% damage for S1 if the target has at least 2 Bleed Count, +20% for S2 at 5 or more, and +40% for S3 at 9 or more. S1's condition is easy to meet. The S2 and S3 bonuses demand high Count and are hard to reach outside the Mirror Dungeon.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「黒雲刀」(色欲×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)は出血の敵: **Passives**: The combat passive Kokuuntō (3 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +10% damage against enemies with Bleed. The support passive Muscle in Charge (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +1 to the Bleed inflicted by the 1 fastest ally.
messages.出血編成に入れ、味方が出血を入れたりマッチを取ったりした敵に、S2・S3を一方攻: Put her in a Bleed team and land S2 and S3 as one-sided attacks on enemies that allies have already bled or Clashed with, extending Bleed Count. S3's Offense Level Down also helps the Clashes of allies who follow. Her own damage is modest, so use her as a role that raises the whole team's Bleed damage rather than one who wears enemies down herself.
